idea-plugin.name: Dependency License Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Dependency License Lens — Know Your Licenses Before They Become Legal Problems

Scan your project dependencies for license information and identify compliance risks directly in your IDE. See license types inline in build files, detect conflicts, and ensure your dependency stack is legally safe.

Features

  • License Detection — Automatically resolves licenses from Maven Central metadata
  • Inline Hints — License type shown next to each dependency in build files
  • Risk Levels — Color-coded: 🟢 Permissive, 🟡 Weak Copyleft, 🔴 Strong Copyleft
  • Conflict Detection — Flags incompatible license combinations
  • Compliance Dashboard — All dependencies grouped by license and risk level
  • Build System Support — Gradle (Kotlin + Groovy) and Maven
  • Unlimited dependencies
  • npm/yarn/pnpm, pip/poetry, Go modules support
  • SBOM export (SPDX and CycloneDX)
  • Policy enforcement with allowed/denied lists
  • Transitive dependency analysis
  • CI integration with SARIF output

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1+ (or any JetBrains IDE)
  • Project with Gradle or Maven build files

Support

Documentation | Issue Tracker | Contact Support

idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.8.0

  • The plugin is now completely free — all features unlocked, no license needed.
  • Source code is now open source under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/JirakJ/dependency-license-lens

What's New

  • Automatic License Scanning - Detects licenses for all project dependencies from Maven Central metadata
  • Inline License Hints - Shows license type directly in build files (Gradle, Maven, npm)
  • Risk Indicators - Color-coded risk levels: green (permissive), yellow (weak copyleft), red (strong copyleft)
  • Conflict Detection - Identifies incompatible license combinations in your dependency tree
  • Compliance Dashboard - Tool window showing all dependencies grouped by license and risk level
  • Gutter Icons - Visual markers for dependencies with license warnings or conflicts
  • Local Caching - Caches resolved licenses locally for fast subsequent scans
  • SBOM Export - Generate SPDX and CycloneDX software bill of materials
  • Policy Enforcement - Define allowed, denied, and review-required license lists
  • Transitive Analysis - Traces license obligations through the entire dependency tree
